license_line.standard: 13 states, including Florida by telehealth registration
license_line.rule: Write '13 states, including Florida by telehealth registration' (12 APRN licenses + Florida TPAN3355 out-of-state telehealth registration). Never '12 states', 'plus a Florida telehealth registration', '+ FL telehealth reg.', or 'Florida-licensed'.
license_line.settled_by: Chris, 2026-10-24 (replaces the 2026-10-21 '12 states / never 13 states' rule)

washington_public_page.rule: Print the Washington ARNP license number ARNP.AP.61670388-NP on /washington-telemedicine/ and /credentials/. Do not remove or redact it.
washington_public_page.settled_by: Chris, 2026-10-15 (replaces the 2026-10-14 'Do not print the Washington license number' rule)

acute_care_credential.name: Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner - Board Certified (AGACNP-BC)
acute_care_credential.rule: Write AGACNP-BC. A bare ACNP-BC (not preceded by AG) blocks a push.

banned_word_allowed_phrases: collaborative agreement with a Georgia-licensed physician
collaborative agreement with a North Carolina-licensed physician
collaborative agreement with an NC physician
banned_word_allowed_phrases_rule: Exact phrases Chris approved on 2026-10-14 despite the word 'physician': GA/NC collaborative-agreement and 'not a physician' disclosures, and source-citation organization names. Matched case-insensitively as whole phrases; the same word anywhere else still blocks. Add more only after Chris says yes to each one.
